propositions: DC transport raises JIRAError which is not caught by existing urllib.error.HTTPError handlers in dispatch_apply_phases.py and outbound_differ.py, causing exceptions to escape instead of degrading gracefully or classifying deleted issues
outbound_differ._safe_get_issue cannot identify remotely-deleted issues on DC backend because JIRAError does not match the HTTPError or URLError/TimeoutError/OSError exception handlers
Core modules import urllib.error.HTTPError directly, creating a vendor-specific transport leak that does not scale to additional backends
BackendHTTPError must be declared as a subclass of urllib.error.HTTPError on the port and raised by all backends to provide a neutral exception contract
DC transport must translate JIRAError to BackendHTTPError at the adapter boundary, preserving HTTP status codes so existing core exception handlers continue to work without modification
